basics.name: Ginny Li
basics.label: Computational Biologist
basics.summary: Computational biologist with deep expertise in cancer proteogenomics and multi-omics integration, leading end-to-end analyses from hypothesis generation to biomarker discovery and high-impact publication across rare and common cancers.

work.name: Hoffmann-La Roche Limited
work.summary: Led computational analyses of epigenetic and ctDNA data to support biomarker discovery and translational oncology projects, collaborating closely with biology and clinical teams.

work.name: University of Michigan
work.summary: Led CPTAC proteogenomics analyses of rare and heterogeneous kidney cancers, integrating multi-omic data to identify diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in close collaboration with pathologists.
